payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_record_refs.py::test_an_interrupted_push_leaves_no_process_behind stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/record/refs.py. The claim was "A `KeyboardInterrupt` raised while a record push waits reaches the caller unchanged, and leaves no process behind. Ctrl-C raises it, and so does SIGTERM under `_guarding_sigterm`. The witness raises it from a `SIGALRM` handler 2.5 seconds into a push against the same stand-in. It drives `RefsRecord.push`, then `RefsRecord.append` with a `remote`. For each it reads git's own `returncode` set at the interrupt, without polling it. It also reads at least five new beats there, then the count unchanged one second later.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
